decision.summary: Urgent no-heating job upgraded to emergency because the tenant is vulnerable and temperatures are 3-5C. HeatRight assignment failed once, then verified on retry; HeatRight no-showed. Missed visit recorded, Swift assigned for same day, tenant and landlord told, P1 escalated.

answers.question: What happened when you assigned the contractor and how did you verify it?
answers.answer: First attempt to assign HeatRight returned HTTP 500 and the ledger showed NOT APPLIED (ticket still at init). I retried once; it succeeded and read-back showed stage visit (A1). I told nobody it was booked until verified.

answers.question: What do you tell the tenant at each point?
answers.answer: Only one tenant message was sent in this run, after the no-show (A4): apology, Swift reassigned for 3-7pm as an unconfirmed target, warmth and gas safety advice, update by 5pm. By email as he prefers. Not sent before the no-show: a visit confirmation for the HeatRight 8-12 window.

answers.question: After the no-show, what do you do?
answers.answer: Recorded missed_appointment, reassigned to Swift (emergency, vulnerable tenant), emailed tenant and landlord, escalated P1 for phone confirmation and temporary heating, and set a 17:00 follow-up.

args.body: Hi Jonah, I'm really sorry. HeatRight's engineer was off sick and they didn't tell us, so nobody came this morning after you took time off work. That's not good enough. We've now sent Swift Plumbing & Heating, a Gas Safe registered firm, and asked them to attend today (Sunday) between 3pm and 7pm. As they haven't yet confirmed that slot with us, please treat it as our target and I'll email you as soon as they do. Because it's an emergency for you, we're treating it as same-day. In the meantime, please stay warm: layers, blankets, a warm room, and let us know if you feel unwell. If you ever smell gas, leave the property and call 0800 111 999. I'll update you by 5pm today whatever happens.
